Question: Let \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) be three distinct one-digit numbers. What is the maximum value of the sum of the roots of the equation \[ \begin{aligned} &(x-a)(x-b) \\ &\quad +(x-b)(x-c)=0? \end{aligned} \]
